reader.requirement: At --std 85 a quotation mark inside a nonnumeric literal is written as two contiguous quotation marks and denotes one quotation-mark character of the value, in every place a nonnumeric literal may appear (procedure operands, VALUE, ALL literal, continued literals), and an undoubled quotation mark ends the literal.

reader.notes: The doubled-mark rule is one edition-independent lexer fragment plus one decoder; every probed position (VALUE, ALL, MOVE, DISPLAY, continuation) yields one quotation mark. The refusal diagnostics for the undoubled form cite §2023 text at --std 85, a wording matter only.
